title: A KEYBOARD MARKER ON THE WINDOW THE KEYS PLAY
why: His answer 3.5 c: the keys play whichever window is in front, plus a marker on each screen showing where the keyboard is. With two windows paired, the front one now wears a small keyboard chip in its top left corner and the other wears none. A lone window never shows it.
now: With two windows paired, the one in front shows a small keyboard chip in its top left corner.
